fabro-60a0's `prompts/survey.md` still flags missing_file after this fix — that flag comes from check-bare-paths (bare path, no line anchor), which resolves against repo root and the develop workflow dir only, not workspace member roots; the same wrong-base false-positive class exists there but is outside this seed's stated scope (report-don't-fix).
